summary: The Embassy of Yemen in Washington sets out visa requirements for US passport holders and lists other nationalities that need a visa — among them the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain, Japan and Australia — asks for an invitation letter from Yemen's Department of Immigration with applications, and says it is not issuing tourist visas at this time. Canada's travel advice says Yemeni authorities do not issue visas at ports of entry. No official page we could read states the rule for passports the embassy does not list.

payments.text: Canada's travel advice says Yemen's economy is primarily cash-based, credit cards are accepted only in some major hotels, and ATMs may only be available in major cities.

safety.text: The FCDO advises against all travel to the whole of Yemen because of unpredictable security conditions, and says anyone there should leave immediately. It says that since July 2026 the Houthis have launched air strikes on Saudi territory and shipping, with a risk of further escalation; that terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks; that there is a very high threat of kidnap; and that landmines are a risk on the roads. British Embassy services in Sana'a are suspended, so support is severely limited.

tips.text: The UK and Canadian governments both advise against all travel to Yemen, Canada including Socotra; Canada cites armed conflict, terrorist attacks and kidnapping.
The UK Foreign Office says there are not many ATMs outside Sana'a and US dollars in cash are the most easily convertible currency; Canada says credit cards are accepted only in some major hotels.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Yemen?
faq.answer: For the nationalities the Embassy of Yemen in Washington lists, yes. The Embassy asks for an invitation letter from Yemen's Department of Immigration with visa applications, lists Gulf states including Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Kuwait and Bahrain among the nationalities that need a visa, and says it is not issuing tourist visas at this time. Canada's travel advice says Yemeni authorities do not issue visas at ports of entry. No official page we could read states the rule for passports the embassy does not list.

faq.question: Is it safe to visit Yemen?
faq.answer: No. The UK and Canadian governments both advise against all travel to Yemen, and the UK Foreign Office says emergency services have severely limited capacity as a result of the conflict.

faq.question: Can tourists still visit Socotra?
faq.answer: Canada's travel advice says to avoid all travel to Yemen, including the island of Socotra, which it says has been under the de facto control of a separatist group since 2020. The UK advises against all travel to the whole of Yemen.

faq.question: Does Yemen have an eVisa or visa on arrival?
faq.answer: No official source we could read describes a Yemeni eVisa. Canada's travel advice says Yemeni authorities do not issue visas at ports of entry and that you must obtain your visa well in advance at the closest Yemeni diplomatic mission.

faq.question: Can I enter Yemen with an Israeli passport or Israeli stamps?
faq.answer: No official source we could read states Yemen's rule for Israeli passport holders. Canada's travel advice says you could be denied entry if your passport bears an Israeli visa or border stamp, or an Egyptian or Jordanian border stamp issued by an office bordering Israel.
